statement: xpadneo's debug subsystem logs descriptor length, a CRC-16 and firmware-version metadata and may print complete unpatched HID descriptors when explicit debug is enabled or a local-administered Bluetooth identity is detected. These logs can include identifying metadata; none of their captured content should be committed to the public corpus without private capture review and sanitization.
